e5e09ff29d7eb430.column_purpose: Antinuclear antibody titer, expressed as reciprocal dilution values (0, 4, 16, 64, 256, ... 4096), i.e. doubling dilutions; 0 = negative.

92e94df136222462.column_purpose: Immunofluorescence staining pattern of the ANA test, comma-separated codes; S likely = speckled, P = peripheral/rim, D = diffuse/homogeneous (plausible reading; exact code legend not in data).

87f043e28140f78b.column_purpose: Clinical diagnosis, abbreviated: SLE = systemic lupus erythematosus, SjS = Sjögren's syndrome, RA = rheumatoid arthritis, MCTD = mixed connective tissue disease, DM = dermatomyositis; 'susp' = suspected; multiple diagnoses comma-separated. Null = no/undocumented diagnosis.

7bcc1c4a66e75b4f.column_purpose: Date of the examination (stored as text, YYYY-MM-DD), ranging 1989-04-18 to 1998-04-17.

c8f4bbe3e381f4d3.column_purpose: Highly unique numeric ID, most likely the patient identifier linking to the Patient table (no join detected, but 763 distinct values over 806 rows suggests repeated examinations per patient).

96eec98304c7e180.column_purpose: Lupus anticoagulant test via kaolin clotting time; '+' positive, '-' negative; mostly null (test not always performed).

327e08b25191472e.column_purpose: Lupus anticoagulant test overall result; '+' positive, '-' negative; mostly null when not tested.

b8574f9c137af391.column_purpose: Lupus anticoagulant test via dilute Russell viper venom time; '+' positive, '-' negative; mostly null when not tested.

df14d38c5320c7ad.column_purpose: Free-text clinical manifestations, mostly thrombotic/obstetric events consistent with antiphospholipid syndrome: CNS lupus, brain infarction, AMI (acute myocardial infarction), PH (pulmonary hypertension?), thrombocytopenia, DVT, thrombophlebitis, abortion. Mostly null.

a194d812f21ccc50.column_purpose: Number of thrombotic events (0-3); 0 = none, higher values = multiple episodes.

6528a5ebd1cccf69.column_purpose: Anticardiolipin antibody IgA level (units not documented; likely GPL/MPL-like units); 0 = negative, extreme max 48547 suggests occasional very high titers.

ead56bac5ecf4059.column_purpose: Anticardiolipin antibody IgG level (likely GPL units); 0 = negative.

18b98556fc4b6f5e.column_purpose: Anticardiolipin antibody IgM level (likely MPL units); 0 = negative, extreme max 187122 suggests occasional very high titers.

2af50e110ea8486a.column_purpose: Albumin, g/dL (range 1.0-5.8, typical 3.5-5.0). Low values consistent with nephrotic-range proteinuria in autoimmune disease.

fbc5586788f00abc.column_purpose: APTT, seconds (range 57-146, median ~95; prolonged vs normal ~25-35, consistent with lupus anticoagulant screening). Measured in <1% of rows.

f641b282c1d985a3.column_purpose: Serum C3, mg/dL (range 15-196, median ~69; low levels typical of SLE activity).

7c6292d1f8cde781.column_purpose: Serum C4, mg/dL (range 3-80, median ~21; low in SLE).

d7e1471e165e3545.column_purpose: Anti-centromere antibody result; values 'negative'/'0' (and possibly titer-style numbers). Almost never measured (99.9% null).

7b1758cc8a979da5.column_purpose: CPK, U/L (range 0-10835, median ~35; high values indicate muscle involvement such as myositis).

c82bc4eaac54b28a.column_purpose: Creatinine, mg/dL (range 0.1-17.1, median 0.7; high values reflect renal failure).

03645c4af93fb87e.column_purpose: CRP result; stored inconsistently as semi-quantitative ('-', '+', '2+') and numeric strings with limits ('<0.3', '2.18'). Mixed-format inflammation marker, mg/dL when numeric.

7db7b9ba681532ef.column_purpose: Anti-double-stranded DNA antibody titer/value (range 0.56-185, median ~23). Measured in <1% of rows; characteristic SLE marker.

32f63395de0a2fde.column_purpose: Second anti-dsDNA antibody column, likely a repeat or alternative assay alongside DNA; plausibly a different measurement method (e.g., RIA vs. IF), but no direct evidence distinguishes it from a duplicate entry of the same test.

225f3dbf62b2f66a.column_purpose: Fibrinogen, likely mg/dL in tens (range 23.8-106.5, median 39) — possibly recorded in units of 10 mg/dL given normal fibrinogen 200-400 mg/dL. Measured in ~3% of rows. Alternative reading: values in µmol/L (normal 6-12), which fits less well.

1177b6001e4a4269.column_purpose: Hemoglobin, g/dL (range 1.3-18.9, median 12.5; anemia common in this cohort).

5c98c76d322e87f2.column_purpose: Identifier of the patient; references Patient.ID (many lab rows per patient; 302 distinct patients over 13908 rows).

1659985d1b12b320.column_purpose: Immunoglobulin G, mg/dL (range 3-6510, median ~1666; elevated in autoimmune disease).

e1f96c6ea4967445.column_purpose: Prothrombin time, seconds (range 10.1-27, median ~12.4). Measured in ~4.5% of rows.

bf79c7d25d9c7005.column_purpose: Semi-quantitative rheumatoid arthritis test result: '-', '+-', '+', '2+' (one stray '7-' likely data entry error).

b71202fe219d7ffa.column_purpose: RF titer/value, IU or U/mL; stored as text with '<' limit values ('<40', '<20.5') and numerics (up to ~98).

ce98ef9f07ea1721.column_purpose: Anti-ribonucleoprotein antibody result: 'negative'/'0' or titer-style numbers (1, 4, 16, 64, 256 — doubling-dilution titers).

861576ae960517d3.column_purpose: Anti-Scl-70 (topoisomerase I) antibody, scleroderma marker: 'negative'/'0' or titer numbers (1, 4, 16). Almost never measured.

c11866de5ac0fbcb.column_purpose: Anti-Smith antibody result: 'negative'/'0' or titer numbers (1, 2, 8). SLE-specific marker, rarely measured.

e76f3960796d6d7f.column_purpose: Anti-SSA (Ro) antibody result: 'negative'/'0' or titer numbers (1, 16, 64, 256).

4794d2f831fff800.column_purpose: Anti-SSB (La) antibody result: 'negative'/'0' or titer numbers (1, 2, 32).

97d0c982b146c59d.column_purpose: Urinary protein (dipstick/quantitative): '-', '0', 'TR' (trace), numeric amounts, '>=1000' (mg/dL), and stray '%%' entry error.

c9e64c1ce60516d3.column_purpose: Admission status flag: '-' (outpatient/not admitted, 713), '+' (admitted, 488), '+(' (admitted with parenthetical note, 3), blank (unknown, 34). Alternative reading: could mark whether the patient was hospitalized at the time of the recorded visit rather than a general status.

75469252c816466d.column_purpose: A date despite the name; 1991-1998 range, low uniqueness, 17% null. Likely the date of a clinical description/case report entry, but the exact event is unresolved; no joined column clarifies it.

4a8f96e58a962902.column_purpose: Primary diagnosis, mostly rheumatic/autoimmune disease abbreviations: SLE (systemic lupus erythematosus), SJS (Sjögren's syndrome), RA (rheumatoid arthritis), Behçet's, PSS (progressive systemic sclerosis), DM (dermatomyositis), PN (polyarteritis nodosa). Free text, may list multiple diagnoses.

7386a4eb5c6dc996.column_purpose: Date of the patient's first visit or disease onset record (1972-1998), 20% null. Could alternatively be the date of first presentation at this registry rather than disease onset; Laboratory rows are keyed by patient and date but do not disambiguate this.

ae7c47473ad59d15.column_purpose: Primary key; unique patient identifier, referenced by Laboratory.ID.

19642ecbbc0467de.column_purpose: Patient sex: F (1023), M (202), blank (13). Strong female predominance consistent with autoimmune disease cohort.
